about_the_game:
Echoes of Eclipse is a roguelite shoot ’em up where you can play solo or in local co-op split screen. Choose your champion, develop your skills in real time, use companions, items and crafting to face changing challenges.

Survive the Eclipse Alone or with a Friend: Play alone or share the screen in local co-op split mode. Coordinate your actions and support each other against enemy waves.



Weapons and Characters: Select from a roster of champions, each with unique weapons, combat styles and abilities.

Element and Skill Variety: Combine different elemental abilities with active and passive skills. Create combinations that fit your style and adjust them to the situation.



Skill Progression in Two Ways: Improve abilities instantly during a run with real time upgrades or build long-term strength through the skill tree system.

Companions: Bring a companion to the battlefield. Companions assist in combat and provide additional support during encounters.

Items and Crafting: Collect unique items and turn them into stronger equipment through crafting. Adjust your gear to meet the needs of each run.

Multiple Game Modes: Access to various modes in development such as multiplayer PvE and PvP. These modes expand the gameplay beyond the standard shoot ’em up format.

Whether you want to push through waves alone, team up with a friend, master complex builds, or experiment with different modes, Echoes of Eclipse offers a blend of action, strategy, and variety that adapts to how you choose to play.

short_description: Echoes of Eclipse is a roguelite shoot ’em up survival game that combines fast-paced combat with strategic skill building. Choose your champion, create your ideal build, and survive relentless enemy waves alone or up to 4 players in local co-op on a constantly changing battlefield.
